rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Created by pengcunfu, this Go-based HTTP request testing server supports all major HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS) with detailed logging capabilities. It features a specialized raw request tool designed for precision security vulnerability testing that preserves every character of payloads without modification, making it ideal for SQL injection, XSS, and authentication bypass testing. All HTTP requests and responses are automatically logged with full details to the user's home directory, providing complete audit trails for debugging and security analysis workflows.
